name: asher-electron
description: Electron frontend for Asher (JSONL transport to Asher.Host)

scripts.build:host: dotnet build ../Asher.SDK/Asher.SDK.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.DebugEnabler/Asher.Patching.DebugEnabler.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.IntroSkipper/Asher.Patching.IntroSkipper.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.GraphicsDeprofiler/Asher.Patching.GraphicsDeprofiler.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.MuteVoiceActing/Asher.Patching.MuteVoiceActing.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.OverheatDisabler/Asher.Patching.OverheatDisabler.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Runtime/Asher.Runtime.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Launcher/Asher.Launcher.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Host/Asher.Host.csproj -c Release -p:Platform=x86
scripts.build:host:debug: dotnet build ../Asher.SDK/Asher.SDK.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.DebugEnabler/Asher.Patching.DebugEnabler.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.IntroSkipper/Asher.Patching.IntroSkipper.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.GraphicsDeprofiler/Asher.Patching.GraphicsDeprofiler.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.MuteVoiceActing/Asher.Patching.MuteVoiceActing.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Patching.OverheatDisabler/Asher.Patching.OverheatDisabler.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Runtime/Asher.Runtime.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Launcher/Asher.Launcher.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86 && dotnet build ../Asher.Host/Asher.Host.csproj -c Debug -p:Platform=x86
scripts.dist: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:host && electron-builder --win dir zip --ia32 && npm run sync:distribution
scripts.dist:publish: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:host && electron-builder --win dir zip --ia32 --publish always && npm run sync:distribution
